arguments.value: 67-year-old man with previously diagnosed CD5-negative, SOX11-negative mantle cell lymphoma involving cecum, bone marrow, and spleen, initially responsive to bendamustine-rituximab, later relapsed with cecal and nodal disease and ultimately transformed in May 2023 to a pleomorphic, high-proliferation (Ki-67 90%), EBV-positive, TP53-abnormal variant confirmed to be clonally related to prior MCL. He was treated with obinutuzumab/polatuzumab for EBV, then received Tecartus CAR-T in September 2023 with subsequent PET showing complete metabolic response and EBV PCR negativity.
